sentences.text:
Annaboina Rayamallu Died As Per Lrs P2 ... vs The Govt. Of
Andhra Pradesh on 8 November, 2024
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.11520 of 2010
Order:

This writ petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India seeking the following relief:
"...to issue a writ order or direction more particularly one in the nature writ of
mandamus directi

ng the respondent neither to dispossess the petitioner from the land bearing Sy.No.345/ extent Ac.2.00 situated at Mancehrial village and Mandal,
Adilabad District nor to assign the same to any third parties or resume the same for Indiramma Gruha Nirmana Scheme for the benefit of third parties without following due procedure under law i.e. without issuing any notice and without consent as long as the assignment granted in his favour is valid and in force by duly declaring the action of the respondent No.2 in taking steps to dispossess the petitioner from the above mentioned land without following any due procedure under law i.e. without issuing any notice and without obtaining his consent as illegal, arbitrary and contrary to the well settled principles of law..."

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue appearing for the respondents and perused the material on record.
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that admittedly this Court has granted interim orders on 20.05.2010 and directed both the parties to maintain status quo existing on that day with regard to the possession in respect of land admeasuring Ac.2.00 comprised in Sy.No.345/ situated at Mancherial Village and Mandal, Adilabad District.

4. In spite of lapse of more than fourteen (14) years, the respondents did not choose to file any counter/vacate petition in this matter for denying the averments made by the petitioners in the writ affidavit.

5. In view of the same, the writ petition is disposed of, directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petitioners' suit schedule property without following due process of law.

If the respondents want to acquire the land of the petitioners, they have to follow the procedure contemplated under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

sentences.text: There shall be no order as to costs.
6. Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.
